up: Provide all activity measurements recorded for the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1614281'. For each activity, include the compound's ChEMBL identifier and preferred name, the activity type (standard_type), the relation (standard_relation), the numeric value (standard_value), the units (standard_units), and the pChemBL value (pchembl_value). sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_pref_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614281';
